newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Letter bomb kills 13-year-old Swiss girl.
newsitem.headline: Letter bomb kills 13-year-old Swiss girl.

text.p: A 13-year-old Swiss girl was killed on Friday and her mother severely injured when a bomb delivered in a package exploded in their home, police said.

Police said the girl found the package when she emptied the mailbox at midday. It exploded when she opened the box with her mother in their sixth-floor apartment in Buchs, on the Austrian border in the northern canton of St Gall.
The girl and her 33-year-old mother, who were not named by police, were rushed to hospital, where the girl died.
"Nothing is known yet about the perpetrators or their motive," St Gall police said in a statement, adding that federal prosecutors had taken over the investigation.
Another bomb exploded the same afternoon in a grocery store in Flawil, about 60 km from Buchs in the same canton, but nobody was hurt as the shop was closed.
Police said they saw no connection for the moment between the blasts.
Another bomb in the same canton injured a 31-year-old Sri Lankan woman in July, when she detonated a charge by opening her mailbox in the town of Rapperswil.
